notes.title: Update 08.08.2023
notes.content:
1. Fix the Portals bug
2. The oak tree does not communicate after the seed is brought (fixed).
3. The Secret Night Light does not show anything (fixed).
4. The keeper teleport bug (fixed).
5. The sale of goods from different sellers has been added.
6. Vsevolod Pogorsky is not a master of trade.
7. A number of minor fixes.

notes.title: Fix bug with max 3 weapon skills.
notes.content: Fix bug with max 3 weapon skills. It was impossible to raise the skill.

notes.title: Update 09.05.2023
notes.content:
Fixed english text display errors: Maces, flail. Golem fillet. Red crystal.
Increased gold content in some places and monsters.
Changing some monster parameters.
Fixed water scroll bug. 
Fixed shop bug (when no active party member, but open shop price window)

notes.title: Fixes and fixes
notes.content:
Fix the disappearance of the description of objects after pointing at the scrolls.
Add new magic effects.
